query:
ALTER TABLE warmup_tasks 
ADD COLUMN recommended_by_ai INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '是否由AI推荐(1=是, 0=否)',
ADD COLUMN ai_recommendation_score FLOAT COMMENT 'AI推荐分数(0-100)',
ADD COLUMN ai_recommendation_reason TEXT COMMENT 'AI推荐理由',
ADD COLUMN before_cache_hit_rate FLOAT COMMENT '预热前缓存命中率',
ADD COLUMN after_cache_hit_rate FLOAT COMMENT '预热后缓存命中率',
ADD COLUMN hit_rate_improvement FLOAT COMMENT '命中率提升百分比',
ADD COLUMN before_avg_response_time INT COMMENT '预热前平均响应时间(毫秒)',
ADD COLUMN after_avg_response_time INT COMMENT '预热后平均响应时间(毫秒)',
ADD COLUMN response_time_improvement FLOAT COMMENT '响应时间改善百分比',
ADD COLUMN effectiveness_score FLOAT COMMENT '效果评分(0-100)'
